queries.name: grand_totals_with_kpi_ratios
queries.purpose: Summarize the main like-for-like trading result and the core basket and pricing KPIs in one-row outputs for the four comparable branches.
queries.intent: Run separate one-row grand total queries, each filtered to the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 using branch filtering that covers 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Query 1: [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], and [revenue growth %], no grouping. Query 2: [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], and [QTY GROWTH %], no grouping. Query 3: [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], and [bills growth %], no grouping. Query 4: [retail price current year], [retail price past year], and [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], no grouping. Query 5: [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], no grouping. Query 6: [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], no grouping.

queries.name: new_branch_cfh022_current_only
queries.purpose: Show the current-period contribution of the new branch CFH022 separately from like-for-like performance.
queries.intent: Run separate one-row queries filtered to only 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] = CFH022 and also apply the same branch filter value to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Query 1: [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], and [revenue Growth], no grouping. Query 2: [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], and [QTY Growth], no grouping. Query 3: [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], and [bills growth], no grouping. Query 4: [UPDATED_DATE], no grouping. This is for current-only branch reporting, so no percentage should be requested if the prior value is zero.

queries.name: comparable_monthly_trend
queries.purpose: Show how like-for-like revenue, quantity and bills have moved over the available months, with the most recent dates first.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows sorted by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] DESCENDING.

queries.name: branch_scorecard
queries.purpose: Compare the four like-for-like branches across sales, units, bills and basket metrics to show which branches are supporting or dragging the group result.
queries.intent: Group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Limit to 15 rows sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] DESCENDING.

queries.name: division_breakdown
queries.purpose: Identify the largest division-level contributors to current sales and show how each division has moved versus last year.
queries.intent: Group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Limit to 15 rows sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] DESCENDING.

queries.name: category_risk_summary
queries.purpose: Measure breadth of category decline and the sales weight of those declining categories, which are both needed for category health reporting.
queries.intent: Run separate one-row queries for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Query 1: [COUNT], [COUNT_TOTAL], [COUNT_PLUS], and [COUNT %], no grouping. Query 2: [sum deg cur rev], [sum deg past rev], [sum total cur rev], [sum total past rev], [contribution cur], and [contribution past], no grouping. These use the model’s own category measures from CAT_TABLE rather than rebuilding category logic from raw columns.

queries.name: top_product_groups_by_current_sales
queries.purpose: Show the largest product groups by current revenue, alongside their movement and operating drivers.
queries.intent: Group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[product_group_name] for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Limit to 15 rows sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] DESCENDING.

queries.name: store_by_special_product_group_cross
queries.purpose: Highlight the largest store-by-category combinations shaping the result, so branch commentary can point to specific commercial pockets.
queries.intent: Group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name] for the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, with the same branch filter also applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior bills as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], and [bills growth]. Limit to 15 rows sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) DESCENDING.
